Title: The Temple Hallowed and the Throne Established
Promise: God had heard Solomon's prayer and hallowed the temple he built, so that God's name would be there for ever, with his eyes and heart there perpetually; and if Solomon walked as David had, God would establish his kingdom's throne over Israel for ever.
Condition: Walking before God as David did, in integrity of heart and uprightness, keeping his statutes and judgments.
Fulfillment: The temple stood as God's house, but the everlasting throne depended on walking as David did, and 1 Kings 11:11 records the kingdom rent from Solomon's son for his disobedience.
